description:
Egocentric Bias — explained in 60 seconds.

You systematically overestimate how much YOU did — in every group, every project, every household.

What actually happens in your brain: Your own effort is fully visible to you. Everyone else's work is invisible unless you look. So your ledger inflates.

Try it today: Before you say 'I did everything', assume your mental ledger is inflated. It is. Thank someone specific today.
